name: Camp Young Judaea (Camp YJ)
description_short: Overnight summer camp in Amherst, NH with Jewish culture programming. For 2027 it offers a seven-week full season, a four-week first session, a three-week second session, and two-week sessions for first-time campers.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Camp YJ Dates and Rates — Camp YJ

warnings: The camp gives two contact sets. The winter office (from September 1) is at 745 High Street, Suite 251, Westwood, MA 02090, phone (781) 237-9410. The summer camp (from June 1) is at 9 Camp Road, Amherst, NH, phone (603) 673-3710. The address recorded is the camp site and the phone recorded is the winter number, which is the current one.
The two-week sessions are for first-time campers only and space is limited.
The site footer says copyright 2024, but the page content is clearly for 2027.
Financial aid is inferred only from a 'Grants and Scholarships' menu link. No details are on this page.
